metadata.purpose: Monitor and improve compliance with acceptance criteria and success metrics from ml_workflow_guidelines.md

compliance.warning: F1 score of 1.0000 may indicate overfitting - requires validation on held-out test set

execution_log.message: Cross-validation failed: The number of folds must be of Integral type. GroupKFold(n_splits=5, random_state=None, shuffle=False) of type <class 'sklearn.model_selection._split.GroupKFold'> was passed.

details.root_cause: GroupKFold object passed instead of integer to cross_val_score cv parameter

compliance.action_required: Fix cross_validate_with_sector_stratification to pass n_splits integer or use GroupKFold correctly

compliance.warning: Ridge model with R²=1.0 and MAE=0.0 indicates severe overfitting or data leakage - investigate feature set for target leakage

issues: Cross-validation with sector stratification failed due to GroupKFold type error
F1 score of 1.0 suggests potential overfitting
Ridge model with perfect R²=1.0 and MAE=0.0 indicates data leakage or overfitting
Model comparison shows suspicious perfect scores for linear models

critical_issues.title: Cross-validation GroupKFold Type Error
critical_issues.description: Cross-validation failed because GroupKFold object was passed instead of integer to cv parameter
critical_issues.root_cause: cross_validate_with_sector_stratification function passes GroupKFold object directly to cross_val_score
critical_issues.recommended_fix: Use GroupKFold.split() method or pass n_splits integer with groups parameter

resolution.fix_applied: Updated cross_validate_classifier in evaluation.py to accept both int and CV splitter objects, added groups parameter support

critical_issues.title: Perfect Model Scores Indicate Data Leakage
critical_issues.description: Ridge model achieves R²=1.0 and MAE=0.0, which is impossible for real financial prediction
critical_issues.root_cause: Likely target leakage - features may contain information derived from target variable
critical_issues.recommended_fix: Audit feature engineering pipeline for target leakage, ensure temporal separation in train/test split

resolution.fix_applied: Added detect_target_leakage() and audit_features_for_training() functions to constraints.py for pre-training feature auditing

critical_issues.title: Classification F1 Score of 1.0 Suggests Overfitting
critical_issues.description: LightGBM achieves perfect F1 score which is unrealistic for financial event classification
critical_issues.root_cause: Possible overfitting due to high model complexity or insufficient regularization
critical_issues.recommended_fix: Validate on held-out test set, increase regularization, reduce max_depth

recommendations.action: Investigate target leakage in feature engineering pipeline
recommendations.rationale: Perfect R² scores are impossible for real financial predictions
Sector-stratified CV is critical for unbiased model evaluation

recommendations.action: Add held-out test set validation for classification
recommendations.rationale: F1=1.0 on training data needs validation on unseen data

recommendations.action: Review train/test split for temporal leakage
recommendations.rationale: Financial data requires time-based splits to prevent look-ahead bias
